full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph shows a young man in a dark hat looking toward the camera amid a close street crowd. The background is a row of modest brick houses, their pale windows and roofline visible above the heads but softened by distance and shallow focus. A cluster of people in dark coats fills the left side, their faces partly hidden behind one another. The young man occupies the central foreground in a dark jacket and brimmed hat. His face is the clearest part of the frame, with straight brows, a concentrated gaze, and pale skin standing out against the black band of his hat and coat. At the right foreground, a young woman in profile faces him. Her dark hair is gathered high, and her cheek and nose are softly lit, but much of her body disappears into the dark edge of the frame. Their shoulders overlap, giving the encounter a crowded, spontaneous intimacy. Behind the man, another face and hat rise in fragments from the group; no one is arranged in a formal pose. The lower portion is nearly solid black from coats and close cropping, while pale house walls give the upper half breathing room. Fine film grain and slightly soft focus around the margins keep the image observational rather than polished. Daylight is overcast and broad, brightening faces and windows without strong cast shadows; darker clothing supplies most of the tonal contrast. The camera is at eye level and close to the crowd, so the viewer feels caught within the same passing moment. The overall composition is immediate and quietly tense, balancing one direct gaze against a woman’s sideways profile and the indistinct movement of the surrounding street.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实照片呈现一位戴深色帽子的年轻男子，在贴近的人群中望向镜头。背景是一排朴素砖房，浅色窗户和屋顶线露在人头上方，却因距离与浅景深而柔化。穿深色外套的人群聚在左侧，面孔互相遮挡。年轻男子位于中央前景，穿深色外套、戴有檐帽。脸是画面最清楚的部分，平直眉毛、专注目光和浅色皮肤从帽带与外套的深黑中突显。右侧前景，一名年轻女子以侧脸面向他。深发高高束起，面颊和鼻子受柔光照亮，大部分身体却消失在画面深暗边缘。两人肩部互相遮挡，使相遇有拥挤而自发的亲近感。男子身后，另一张脸和一顶帽子从人群中片段般露出，没有人摆出正式姿势。下部因深色外套和近距离裁切几乎成为实黑，上半幅的浅色房墙则留出呼吸空间。细胶片颗粒和边缘略柔的焦点使画面更像观察所得，而非磨光的肖像。阴天日光宽散，照亮面孔与窗户，没有强烈投影；深色衣服提供大部分明暗对比。镜头与人群平视且贴近，让观者仿佛置身同一转瞬即逝的时刻。整体构图即时而隐约紧张，以一道直视目光平衡女子的侧脸和周围街道模糊的运动。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photograph uses candid close framing, visible film grain, and a broad overcast tonal range. Dark coats or equivalent near masses compress the lower frame, while pale background planes keep the upper area open. One or two faces or focal details remain sharper than the surrounding crowdlike texture, creating hierarchy through focus rather than staged lighting. Contours overlap closely, and the camera's eye-level viewpoint makes the scene feel physically inhabited. Midtones are soft, highlights restrained, and black areas deep without losing all surface detail. Diffuse daylight avoids hard shadows, allowing gesture and direct gaze to carry tension. The overall effect is humane and immediate, with spontaneous spacing and imperfect photographic texture central to its style.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影运用随手抓拍般的近距离裁切、可见胶片颗粒和宽泛的阴天灰阶。深色衣物或相当的近处体块压缩画面下部，浅色背景平面使上部保持开放。一两处面孔或焦点细节比周围人群般的纹理更清楚，层级来自焦点，而非安排好的灯光。轮廓紧密遮挡，平视镜头让场景显得有人真实置身其中。中间调柔和，亮部克制，黑色区域深而没有失去所有表面细节。漫散日光避免硬影，使姿态和直视目光承载张力。整体效果有人情味而即时，自发的间距和不完美的摄影肌理是画风核心。
theme_en: A young man in a dark hat looking toward the camera amid a street crowd
theme_zh: 一位戴深色帽子的年轻男子在人群中望向镜头
name: Thurston Hopkins
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
